cards.heading: Who We Are
body: Azoogi is an Australian lighting brand dedicated to creating high-quality LED solutions that combine style, performance, and value. We’ve worked on thousands of projects – from homes and apartments to hospitality venues and retail spaces – and we’re trusted by leading trades and designers nationwide.

cards.heading: What We Do
body: We supply premium LED lighting products for every kind of space – indoor, outdoor, decorative, and architectural. Our range includes modern downlights, feature pendants, LED strip systems, and smart control options. Whether it’s creating atmosphere or delivering functional task lighting, we’ve got it covered.

cards.heading: How We Can Help
body: We make it easy to get the right lighting for your project. Need advice on what to choose? We can help. Want a custom solution? We can design it. Looking for a cost-effective alternative to something you’ve seen elsewhere? We’ll match or improve it without compromising on quality.

cards.heading: Quality You Can Trust
body: Every Azoogi product is built to last, tested for performance, and backed by our commitment to service. With nationwide availability through trusted wholesalers and retailers, you can be confident that you’re getting lighting that looks great, works perfectly, and stands the test of time.

audiences.title: For Interior & Lighting Designers
lead: At Azoogi, we understand that lighting is more than illumination… it’s the art of shaping atmosphere, evoking emotion, and bringing your vision to life. That’s why Australia’s leading interior and lighting designers choose Azoogi for products that balance style, performance, and reliability.

From luxurious residences to high-impact retail spaces and boutique commercial fit-outs, our solutions give you the freedom to design boldly, specify with certainty, and deliver projects that impress from every angle.

cards.heading: Design-Focused LED Lighting
body: Our range is crafted to enhance contemporary interiors — from sleek profiles and atmospheric strip lighting to statement decorative pieces and precision architectural fittings. With customisable finishes and versatile mounting options, every detail can be tailored to bring your design vision to life.

cards.heading: Built for Specifications
body: We make specifying effortless by offering comprehensive spec sheets, IES and Photometric files, DALI and dimmable options, Casambi-ready solutions, as well as emergency and smart integrations. No unnecessary extras, just professional-grade products from a trusted partner, designed to streamline your documentation and keep projects moving.

cards.heading: Designed for Designers
body: You care about the experience – and so do we. Our lighting is crafted to reveal texture, define form, and influence how people feel and move within a space. From layered lighting schemes to precise task solutions, we work with you to bring your creative vision to life without compromise.
For any questions please email sales@azoogi.com or majorprojects@azoogi.com

cards.heading: Seamless Trade Handover
body: We help you hand over projects with confidence. Every Azoogi product is engineered for practical installation, making life easier for electricians and contractors. With bespoke delivery solutions and on-site support, we minimise complications, ensure smooth handovers, and bring your design to life exactly as intended.

cards.heading: Install With Ease, Build With Confidence
body: At Azoogi, we know that the right lighting solution doesn’t just look great – it makes your job faster, simpler, and more profitable. That’s why electricians, builders, and developers across Australia trust us for products that combine reliability, technical performance, and fast turnaround times.

From high-end residential builds to large-scale commercial fit-outs, our solutions are engineered for straightforward installation, backed by expert engineering advice, and supported through our national wholesaler network.
Capability statement available please email at majorprojects@azoogi.com

cards.heading: Trade Focused LED Lighting
body: Our products are designed with the installer in mind – quick-connect systems, consistent quality control, and fittings that perform as promised. Whether you need architectural downlights, LED strip systems, weatherproof fittings, or feature lighting we supply the right gear for the job.

With flexible mounting options, multiple control protocols, and adaptable configurations, we make it easy to match the right product to your client’s needs while keeping your project on schedule and on budget.

cards.heading: Built for the Trade
body: We remove the guesswork from lighting. Every product comes with clear installation guides, wiring diagrams, and full compliance documentation. Need advice? Our technical team is on hand to help with design layouts, circuit loading, and control integration — from DALI and Casambi to emergency and smart solutions.
With our products available through leading electrical wholesalers nationwide, you can source what you need when you need it, without costly delays.

cards.heading: Engineered for Efficiency
body: Time is money on site. That’s why Azoogi products are tested for fast, trouble-free installation — from pre-terminated connections to consistent colour matching across batches. We offer custom pre-cut and pre-wired LED strip services, tailored lighting solutions, and engineering advice to ensure everything works first time.
From pre-construction planning through to final commissioning, we work alongside you to help deliver projects on time, on budget, and exactly to spec.

cards.heading: Stock With Confidence, Sell With Ease
body: At Azoogi, we don’t just supply lighting – we help you build a reputation for quality, reliability, and innovation. That’s why leading electrical wholesalers and lighting retailers choose us as their go-to supplier.
With an ever-expanding product range, competitive pricing, and dependable service, we give you everything you need to keep your shelves stocked with in-demand products that your customers trust.

cards.heading: Innovative, In-Demand Product Range
body: From sleek architectural downlights and premium LED strip systems to decorative statement pieces and smart lighting solutions, our catalogue is designed to cover every market segment.
We constantly update our range to reflect new trends, technologies, and customer demands – helping you stay ahead of the competition and attract repeat business.

cards.heading: Award-Winning Products & Service
body: Our commitment to quality has been recognised with industry awards, but more importantly, it’s reflected in the trust our partners place in us. Every Azoogi product is engineered to perform, tested for consistency, and supported by comprehensive spec sheets, IES files, and compliance documentation.
Our wholesale and retail partners also benefit from responsive support, streamlined ordering, and nationwide delivery – making it easy to get the right product to the right customer, fast.

cards.heading: Solutions That Sell
body: We design our products to offer exceptional value without compromising on quality – giving you better margins, fewer returns, and happier customers. From bulk-buy pricing and tailored promotions to exclusive product lines, we help you grow sales while protecting your profitability.
With Azoogi, you get more than a supplier – you get a partner committed to helping you stand out in the market and keep customers coming back.

cards.heading: Off-Spec Solutions That Win the Job
body: When a project spec calls for an overpriced brand or your client has cost restraints and flex, Azoogi gives you the power to offer a smarter alternative. Our team can review project lighting schedules, provide matching or improved specifications, and tailor solutions to meet budget without compromising quality or performance.

This not only helps your customers win more projects – it positions you as a problem-solver who delivers value beyond the box. With our in-house engineering advice, custom manufacturing options, and rapid turnaround on quotes, we help you secure sales that competitors might otherwise lose.
